name: the-way-coach3d
description: Builds pwa/coach3d.js (the 3D coach: three.js + TalkingHead, bundled) and compresses the avatar. Run: npm install && npm run build

scripts.avatar: gltf-transform optimize avatar-src/coach.glb ../../pwa/avatar/coach.glb --compress meshopt --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false --join false --flatten false --instance false --palette false --weld false
